title: S4-EXPORT-06 — A replay remembers the latest stroke.
goal: After two strokes the timelapse reports the recorded stroke snapshots and is ready to download; exporting it does not use up Undo, which still steps back exactly one stroke.

steps.why: The timelapse counts the strokes it will replay.
The export is ready; this plan does not start the browser download (the file itself is checked outside the App run).
The export leaves the latest stroke in place.
Undo still steps back exactly one stroke: exporting did not consume history.

cliOnly: decoding the replay GIF and checking that its last frame is the latest visible artwork (tests/production/timelapseIntegrity.spec.ts)
